sampling.method: stratified random, one query per card

query_style: task-style Chinese utterance written from the card description; target card name/title not reused

decision_rule_preregistered.keep: semantic hit@1 >= keyword hit@1 + 20pp AND semantic p95 <= 3s
decision_rule_preregistered.revert: semantic hit@1 < keyword hit@1 OR semantic p95 > 5s
decision_rule_preregistered.note: keyword here means the then-current MethodStore.list CJK term matching; bigram channel is a diagnostic, not part of the rule

disclosure: Queries were fixed in a scratch file at 07:57 before the first run; this committed file is the same content, hashed below. First run was exploratory before commit; reproduction run after commit is recorded in the results file.
